audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of all four stages of Sam’s composer storyline: his search for work, the Zuzu Broadcasting offer and every quick-question branch, song development, and the completed children’s song with Vincent and Jas. Every spoken line, response option, career and family beat, show and employer name, music-production explanation, joke, reward object, and affectionate line was reviewed in full context with canonical Junimo terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, mail and special-order state, quick-question branch counts, placeholders, gender and dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining FarmHouse records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
